component.name: Forza Horizon 1: ReImagined
component.summary: Build and play Forza Horizon (Xbox 360) natively, from your own game files

description.p: Forza Horizon 1: ReImagined is a static recompilation of Forza Horizon (Xbox 360) to a native Linux program. This launcher builds the game on your computer from your own copy of Forza Horizon and then runs it, with Vulkan rendering, keyboard, mouse and controller support, a frame rate you choose, and online play through a Forza Live server.

No game code and no game data are included. You need your own Games on Demand package of Forza Horizon (base version); the Title Update 4 package is optional but recommended (Horizon Rally, the 1000 Club). The launcher extracts your files, translates the game's executable to C++ and compiles it inside this sandbox, using the freedesktop SDK and its LLVM extension, so no compiler or development packages are needed on your system.
Forza Horizon is a trademark of Microsoft. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Microsoft, Playground Games or Turn 10 Studios.
The first build takes about five minutes on a modern 8-core computer and needs about 15 GB of free disk space. Saves, settings and logs stay in the application's data folder.
First release: the launcher, with Title Update 4 (Horizon Rally, the 1000 Club) and online play.
